name: Biotransference
oracle_text:
Creatures you control are artifacts in addition to their other types. The same is true for creature spells you control and creature cards you own that aren't on the battlefield.
Whenever you cast an artifact spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 black Necron Warrior artifact creature token.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 black Necron Warrior artifact creature token.

needs.what: a 2/2 black Necron Warrior artifact creature token (types Artifact Creature, subtypes Necron Warrior, no abilities)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Necron Warrior; the nearest are warrior_1_1_r / warrior_1_1_w (wrong size, colour, not artifact) and elf_warrior_1_1_g. The rest of the card is expressible: the first line is an add_subtype static with types ["Artifact"] on creatures you control plus an off_battlefield add_subtype static for creature spells and cards, and the trigger is spell_cast with filter types ["Artifact"] doing lose_life 1 then create_token.
